       1             SENATOR SMITH:  We are here this morning to

       2      obviously talk about the YDD Program

       3      (the Youth Development Delinquency Program), as well

       4      as, equally as important, the impact of the proposed

       5      minimum-wage increase on the Summer Youth Employment

       6      Program.

       7             As many of you know, the Summer Youth

       8      Employment Program is a very critical program for

       9      young people throughout the state of New York.

      10             And we believe there has not been enough

      11      attention or enough analysis that has been done with

      12      regard to the impact of a minimum wage on the

      13      Summer Youth Employment Program.

      14             We all support the idea of increasing the

      15      minimum wage, and what we don't want to get lost --

      16      in particular, if the minimum wage is increased

      17      between now and June, what we don't want to get lost

      18      is the fact that there could be a regressive impact

      19      on the number of slots that become available for the

      20      summer youth program, in that, most people don't

      21      equate the amount of money that is coming for the

      22      summer youth program to -- as a whole number, versus

      23      what that would mean if minimum wage was increased.

      24             So, we have a number of people who will be

      25      testifying today:
